prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable, objective “best” without comparing bids and checking recent work. **Art’s Roofing & Construction** looks like a strong candidate from the available information: it says it handles Miami-Dade HVHZ-compliant replacements, permits and inspections, and provides a written workmanship warranty. **AGK Construction & Roofing** is another option; it states that it uses Miami-Dade NOA-approved materials and lists an active Florida roofing license.

Before choosing, get at least three written bids and verify each contractor’s license and insurance. Ask for the exact roofing system’s Miami-Dade Notice of Acceptance (NOA) or Florida Product Approval, the permit and inspection plan, and separate written workmanship and manufacturer warranties. Confirm the proposed assembly—not just the roofing material—is approved for your home’s wind exposure and roof structure. Sources: [Art’s Roofing](https://www.artsroofing.com/) · [AGK Construction & Roofing](https://agkgc.com/miami-roofing)
